compute_box_iou: compute the intersection over union between two sets of bounding boxes using box_iou
convert_box_formats: convert bounding boxes between xyxy, cxcywh, and xywh formats using box_xyxy_to_cxcywh
compute_generalized_box_iou: compute the generalized IoU between two sets of bounding boxes using generalized_box_iou
compute_mask_costs: compute dice, focal, or BCE mask costs between predicted and target masks using dice_cost
extract_grid_from_boxes: extract grid features from a feature map at specified bounding box locations using extract_grid
